senses.gloss: ch. (cmp. פדד, s. v. פַּדָּן) to split; to wound.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Kings 20:37">Targ. I Kings XX, 37</cite> (h. text <he>פצע</he>).—
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 109b:3">Snh. 109ᵇ</cite> <he>דפ׳ ליה לחבריה וכ׳</he> (in Sodom) when a person wounded his neighbor, they told him, pay him for bleeding thee.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 109b">Ib.</cite> <he>פַּדְעֵיה</he> Ms. M. one (of them) struck him; ed. <he>פַּדְיוּהִי</he>, <he>פַּדְיוּהוּ</he> (fr. <cite ref="Q00117"><he>פדי</he></cite>) they struck him.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 12">Lev. R. s. 12</cite>; <cite ref="Esther Rabbah 4:12">Esth. R. to I, 22</cite> (Par. 5) <he>מחיוניה ופַדְעוּנֵיה</he> they struck him and wounded him; a. e.
